Setup
```{r}
setwd("~/Desktop/AMES_LAB/CODE_STUFF")

library(tidyverse)
library(scales) # For elegant axis formatting
```

Load and Prep Data
```{r}
# 1. Load and prep the data
df <- read_csv("matrix_surrogate_dataset.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  # Filter out any infinite or NA values in our target columns
  filter(is.finite(eig_error_relative), is.finite(cond_input)) %>%
  # Create our log-transformed columns and factors for grouping
  mutate(
    log_cond_input = log10(cond_input),
    log_error = log10(eig_error_relative),
    # Convert grouping variables to factors so ggplot treats them as discrete categories
    size_fct = as.factor(size),
    scale_fct = as.factor(scale)
  )
```

Facet Plot
```{r}
# create missing label column for facets 
df <- df %>%
  mutate(scale_label = paste0("Scale (s) = ", scale))

p_multi <- ggplot(df, aes(x = as.factor(log_cond_input), y = log_error, color = size_fct)) +
  # Jitter and dodge the dots inside each panel
  geom_point(position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.2, 
                                             dodge.width = 0.6), 
             alpha = 0.6, size = 2) +
  facet_wrap(~ scale_label) + # Creates the 3 side-by-side panels
  scale_color_viridis_d(option = "viridis") +
  # Format axes to 10^x
  scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) parse(text=paste0("10^", x))) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = math_format(10^.x)) +
  labs(
    title = "Error Scaling by Dimension, Condition, and Scale",
    x = expression("Condition Number (" * kappa * ")"),
    y = "Relative Error",
    color = "Dimension (n)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(legend.position = "right")

ggsave("R_error_multipanel.png", plot = p_multi, width = 12, height = 5, 
       dpi = 300, bg = "white")
print(p_multi)
```

Main Error Plot (All data)
```{r}
p2 <- ggplot(df, aes(x = as.factor(log_cond_input), y = log_error, 
                     color = size_fct, shape = scale_fct)) +
  # position_jitterdodge adds randomness inside the dodged columns!
  geom_point(position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.15, 
                                             dodge.width = 0.6), 
             size = 2.5, alpha = 0.6) +
  scale_color_viridis_d(option = "viridis") +
  # Format axes to 10^x
  scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) parse(text=paste0("10^", x))) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = math_format(10^.x)) +
  labs(
    title = "Algorithm Error: Grouped by Dimension and Scale",
    x = expression("Condition Number (" * kappa * ")"),
    y = "Relative Error",
    color = "Dimension (n)", 
    shape = "Scale (s)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "right")

# Save and show Plot 2
ggsave("R_error_main_plot.png", plot = p2, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300,
       bg = "white")
print(p2)
```


Plot the Variance Analysis (Standard Deviation)
```{r}
# Calculate the standard deviation for each group
df_std <- df %>%
  group_by(log_cond_input, size_fct, scale_fct) %>%
  summarise(std_log_error = sd(log_error), .groups = 'drop')

p1 <- ggplot(df_std, aes(x = as.factor(log_cond_input), y = std_log_error, 
                         color = size_fct, shape = scale_fct)) +
  # position_dodge neatly separates the shapes side-by-side
  geom_point(position = position_dodge(width = 0.5), size = 4, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_color_viridis_d(option = "viridis") + 
  # Format the X-axis to show 10^x
  scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) parse(text=paste0("10^", x))) +
  labs(
    title = "Variance Analysis: Grouped by Dimension and Scale",
    x = expression("Condition Number (" * kappa * ")"),
    y = expression("Standard Deviation of " * log[10] * "(Error)"),
    color = "Dimension (n)", 
    shape = "Scale (s)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "right")

# Save and show Plot 1
ggsave("R_error_std_plot.png", plot = p1, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300,
       bg = "white")
print(p1)
```


Mean analysis
```{r}
# Calculate the standard deviation for each group
df_mean <- df %>%
  group_by(log_cond_input, size_fct, scale_fct) %>%
  summarise(mean_log_error = mean(log_error), .groups = 'drop')

p_mean <- ggplot(df_mean, aes(x = as.factor(log_cond_input), y = mean_log_error, 
                              color = size_fct, shape = scale_fct)) +
  # Add the points on top, dodged to align perfectly
  geom_point(position = position_dodge(width = 0.6), size = 4.5, alpha = 0.9) +
  # Enforce the consistent Viridis color scheme
  scale_color_viridis_d(option = "viridis") + 
  # Format the X-axis to show 10^x
  scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) parse(text=paste0("10^", x))) +
  labs(
    title = "Average Error: Grouped by Dimension and Scale",
    x = expression("Condition Number (" * kappa * ")"),
    y = expression("Mean " * log[10] * "(Relative Error)"),
    color = "Dimension (n)", 
    shape = "Scale (s)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(legend.position = "right",
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

ggsave("R_error_mean_plot.png", plot = p_mean, width = 10, height = 6, 
       dpi = 300, bg = "white")
print(p_mean)
```

Fitting Linear Regression:
```{r}
# 1. Linear Regression on the Mean Error
# We use log_cond_input (numeric) to find the slope, and include size and scale as adjustments
lm_mean <- lm(mean_log_error ~ log_cond_input + size_fct + scale_fct, 
              data = df_mean)

print("=== Linear Regression Results: MEAN ERROR ===")
summary(lm_mean)

# 2. Linear Regression on the Standard Deviation (Variance)
lm_std <- lm(std_log_error ~ log_cond_input + size_fct + scale_fct, 
             data = df_std)

print("=== Linear Regression Results: STANDARD DEVIATION ===")
summary(lm_std)
```
